After adds the explicit 'Evidence captured before the strip' line, the missing-only ref creation, and the FETCH/EDIT ordering ahead of the eligibility section, which settles the fact. Attribution, question and outcomes are unchanged in substance between the two: both carry Absorbs #13/#14, per-PR thread lists with the fffffff first-parent proof for HOME and copied member dispositions, the exact two spec comments with the literal home URL and bbbbbbb/ccccccc, option 1 wording, immediate pre-close rechecks without --delete-branch, and all five variants with ship-complete timing.
